ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $\angle B=50^\circ$. CD is the altitude of $\triangle ABC$, and CE is the angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$. Find the measure of $\angle DCE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $CD$ is the height of $\triangle ABC$,\\
hence $\angle CDB = 90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle DCB = 90^\circ - \angle B = 90^\circ - 50^\circ = 40^\circ$;\\
Since $CE$ bisects $\angle ACB$,\\
thus $\angle ECB = \frac{1}{2} \angle ACB = \frac{1}{2} \times 90^\circ = 45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle DCE = \angle ECB - \angle DCB = 45^\circ - 40^\circ = \boxed{5^\circ}$

method.method_draft: Read from the image: A, C, B form one triangle with C at the top, D lies on AB directly below C, and CD is drawn perpendicular to AB; CE is another segment from C to E on AB. Read from the text: angle ACB = 90 degrees, angle B = 50 degrees, and CE is the angle bisector at C. Use the local angle at C with ray CB as the reference: in right triangle CDB, angle CDB = 90 degrees, so angle DCB = 90 - 50 = 40 degrees. Because CE bisects the 90-degree angle at C, angle ECB = 45 degrees. Then angle DCE is the difference between these two angles at C: 45 - 40 = 5 degrees.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，A 在左下方，B 在右下方，C 在上方，AB 是底边。点 E、D 都在底边 AB 上，且 E 在 D 的左侧。从 C 向底边画了两条线段 CE 和 CD，其中 CD 落到 D，CE 落到 E。题干给出 ∠ACB = 90°，∠B = 50°，CD 是三角形 ABC 的高，CE 是 C 处的角平分线。

推理：因为 CD 是高，所以 CD ⟂ AB，故 ∠CDB = 90°。在直角三角形 CDB 中，∠CBD 与三角形 ABC 的 ∠B 相同，为 50°，所以 ∠DCB = 90° - 50° = 40°。又因为 CE 平分 ∠ACB，而 ∠ACB = 90°，所以 ∠ECB = 45°。因此 ∠DCE = ∠ECB - ∠DCB = 45° - 40° = 5°。
